theorems.name: Submission.bf_starProjection_map_orthogonal
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (g : Rn N →L[ℝ] Rn N), ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint g * g = 1 → ∀ V : Submodule ℝ (Rn N), (V.map (g : Rn N →ₗ[ℝ] Rn N)).starProjection = g * V.starProjection * ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint g ∧ finrank ℝ (V.map (g : Rn N →ₗ[ℝ] Rn N)) = finrank ℝ V
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
